findings.summary: Review-round commit fa43499 edited two RED-committed SC2 assertions after GREEN: the duplicate-count OR-chain was replaced by `eq(..., o.r.duplicates, 1)`, and the token literal `'dummy-sc2-token-xyz'` was replaced by a runtime-built sentinel. The GREEN commit 97fff9c itself did not touch test_code.js, so the tdd anchor is not triggered strictly, but the post-GREEN edit to RED tests is worth recording.
findings.suggestion: No change needed: both edits tighten or de-literalise assertions and every enumerated case still has an assertion. Keep future review fixes to RED tests explicit in the step output, or add a RED re-run after any such edit.

findings.summary: The 'reason names the mismatch' check is a loose regex conjunction (/matched/ plus /2/ and /5/), so it would also pass on unrelated reason text containing those digits.
findings.suggestion: Assert the exact reason string, e.g. eq against 'collected 2 !== matched 5', so the test pins the gate that fired.

findings.summary: On a truncated page, `collected.length >= matched` fails with the reason 'made no progress' even when the producer is simply over-reporting truncation after all matched lines were already collected. The reason text misnames the failure mode, though the result is still fail-closed.
findings.suggestion: Optional: split the two conditions so the 'already complete but truncated' case gets its own reason string, or reword the message to 'truncated with no remaining work'.

findings.summary: SHOP_COFFEE_PAGE_LIMIT x SHOP_COFFEE_MAX_PAGES caps a week at 4000 lines. A larger week fails loudly with ok:false, which is correct, but a future volume increase could be mistaken for a producer fault.
findings.suggestion: No change now. Note the ceiling in the phase docs or prod-probe.md so it is found if weekly volume grows.
